hook: AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to fix my morning routine.
caption:
AI gave me a 47-step plan when I asked how to fix my morning routine.

I asked for help. Not a project proposal.

Here's what happened: ChatGPT didn't know I hate lists. It didn't know I think in outcomes, not steps. It didn't know that when I see a numbered list longer than 5 items, my brain checks out entirely.

So it gave me what it gives everyone — a thorough, organized, completely unusable wall of text.

The fix wasn't a better prompt.

It was teaching the AI how I actually process information before I asked the question.

When bootfile.ai knows you're an Outcome Thinker (one of our 8 thinking styles), it stops giving you the roadmap and just tells you where to end up — and why it matters.

Same question. Completely different answer.

"Cut the morning scroll. Do the hard thing first. Everything else figures itself out."

That's it. That's all I needed.

The AI wasn't broken before. It just didn't know who it was talking to.

Now it does.
